title: Player One
blurb: Video games are where it started. Wanting to know how they worked is what got me writing HTML and C++ at 10.

title: Solder & Circuits
blurb: Electronics tinkering: building and fixing circuits, which pulled me toward mechatronics and automation at UNIPAC.

title: Six Strings
blurb: I play guitar, mostly rock and roll. Learning songs by ear trained the same patience I use when debugging.

title: Keeping Time
blurb: I also play drums. Holding a steady beat for a band is a lot like keeping a release cadence for a team.

title: Origins of Everything
blurb: Astrophysics, space and how the universe began. I read about cosmology for fun and look up whenever the sky is clear.

title: Quantum Fields
blurb: Self-studying quantum field theory, starting with quantum chromodynamics: quarks, gluons and the strong force.

title: The Sci-Fi Shelf
blurb: Science fiction books, films and series. Good sci-fi is half of why I think about what software could become.

title: Friendly Neighborhood
blurb: Spider-Man is my favorite superhero: with great power comes great responsibility, which is a decent motto for anyone with production access.
